_comment: Tool registry. kind: build = implemented by dwo-Lens, wrap = Epic/engine tool driven headless, ai = interpretation. status: ready | planned.

tools.invocation: UnrealEditor-Cmd <uproject> -run=DwoLensInspector -LensOut=<dir>
same commandlet
IAssetRegistry::GetDependencies (inside the commandlet)
parses .uproject, *.Build.cs, *.uplugin
lens_analyze.py
Tarjan SCC on module and asset hard-reference graphs
transitive hard-reference closure per asset
reachability from maps and Config/*.ini; replaces UI-only or paid cleaners
ObjectRedirector detection (fix-up stays manual; ResavePackages would modify packages)
node count, branches, longest exec chain per graph
UE5 style guide prefixes and folder rules from config (Allar Linter has no confirmed UE5 support)
detects the project's own StateMonitor plugin, BP and C++ submit points; adds StateMonitor.* tests to verify
UnrealEditor-Cmd <uproject> -run=CompileAllBlueprints -ShowResultsOnly
UnrealEditor-Cmd <uproject> -run=DataValidation
UnrealEditor-Cmd <uproject> -ExecCmds="Automation RunTests <filters>;Quit" -testexit="Automation Test Queue Empty" -ReportExportPath=<dir>
lens_logs.py: severity, category, fingerprint groups, new-vs-baseline
Saved/Crashes/*/CrashContext.runtime-xml (error message, call stack)
UnrealInsights -OpenTraceFile=<utrace> -unattended -autoquit -noui -ExecOnAnalysisCompleteCmd="TimingInsights.ExportTimerStatistics <csv>"
UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=SummarizeTrace -inputfile=<utrace>
-csvCaptureFrames=N, then Engine/Binaries/DotNET/CsvTools/PerfreportTool -csvdir <dir> -o <out> -writeSummaryCsv
UBT <Target> Win64 Development -StaticAnalyzer=VisualCpp (nightly, code projects only)
UBT -Mode=IWYU -NoCompile (report only, never -Write)
StateMonitor JSONL dump option + collector, joined to the run id with Insights and VisLog
Context Packet from graph.json + findings, unknown relations only
gui.bat (repository) or __dwo-lens.bat gui; Dear ImGui + DirectX 11, built once with MSVC

installs the bundled StateMonitor (prebuilt editor binaries + source) into Plugins/__StateMonitor; editor/PIE only by default so packages are unaffected, --runtime keeps it in game targets; refuses removal while project code references it
tools.output: runtime USTRUCT snapshots, change history, viewer; StateMonitor.* tests in verify
